claims.claim: SpaceX Crew Dragon Grace docked seven hours and fifty-five minutes after liftoff.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX Crew Dragon Grace reached the International Space Station in seven hours and fifty-five minutes, the fastest U.S. spacecraft transit on record.
claims.source_title: SpaceX just locked up a NASA record no other U.S. spacecraft can touch
claims.supporting_quote: Crew Dragon Grace docked to the forward port of the stations Harmony module at 7:05 p.m. ET on October 1, just 7 hours and 55 minutes after lifting off from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral.

claims.claim: ESA signed a new Memorandum of Understanding with Vast at the 77th International Astronautical Congress.
claims.episode_span: The European Space Agency signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Vast at the 77th International Astronautical Congress.
claims.source_title: The European Space Agency and Vast Build on Existing Mission Collaborations and Strengthen Cooperation on Post-ISS
claims.supporting_quote: Signed during the 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026), the MoU reflects the shared interest between ESA and Vast to collaborate in future commercial opportunities in Low Earth Orbit.

claims.claim: The ESA-CAS SMILE mission recorded a full auroral oval visible even during daylight hours.

claims.supporting_quote: full auroral oval , but using ultraviolet light , one that occurred during the day

claims.claim: After six months at “Lac de Charmes” beyond Jezero crater’s western rim, Perseverance encountered a field of light-toned boulders.

claims.claim: New analysis of Hubble observations suggests a planet candidate is accreting onto a white dwarf, implying a second-generation planetary system.
